verdict.rationale: Figma documents an official MCP server, available remotely without the desktop app, that turns selected frames into code and pulls variables, components, and layout data into the IDE. The `get_variable_defs` tool extracts variables and styles, Code Connect maps design-system components to production code, and the REST and Variables APIs offer programmatic extraction. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of screenshot retrieval through the MCP server or API, and independent hands-on corroboration of the design-context-to-code workflow.
